notes.title: Update 20.12.18
notes.notes:
Graphics:

 New effects in slow motion.
 Softer shades and smooth disappearance of the blood of enemies.
 More distinct drawing of characters.
 The laser color of the weapon varies depending on the type of weapon and the shooting mode.
 Enemies who notice the player display an exclamation mark.


 Sound: 

 Sounds and music partially replaced.


 Gameplay: 

 A little storyline fragments.
 Added several levels.
 The character’s melee strike hits flying bullets.
 The total weapon recoil has been changed.
 Changed the behavior of enemies under fire.

notes.title: Little update.
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/037bb640ef2a5104b275468c5af217423ff8e186.png

The game now has a small survival mode with an interesting name. To start, use the new item in the game menu.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/720f9b0b3bcbebf928476fb3e5eb8cd4cd608dca.png

Key features of this mode:
- Timer. A small timer,located at upper part of the map. When it is finished you will be moved back to the menu with saving your highscore. By the way, you can see them in the community or directly in the game by pressing F1 (but it is advisable to do this when you have nothing to lose).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/2d009798686e7b0a7f9569cc3a556bcbb6e887b3.png

-- Score. From different corners of the map there will be crowding enemy waves coming out to you.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/e904a937bec1f89b5bdc9ceb2939ad05f9034467.png

While you are in a square area, your weapons receives a higher rate of fire. Otherwise, the rate of fire is reduced and time stops and kills stops counting in outside of square. Just stay in the box and everything will be fine. In case of lose, your points will also be published in a global leaderboard.

As the time decreases, enemies appear more abruptly and the area of ​​the square expands, thereby allowing you to better control the situation and overcome more powerful enemies.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/55025fd546b27d47e22ab9999aca5d567965d79d.png

Good luck !!!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32871681/5a9f0f205842113dd43a5e373e8888ba23b857e8.png

notes.title: Linux version is right here.
notes.notes:
And the first trouble with it.
Just note, you need OpenAl (tested on Ubuntu 16.04 x64) and, in general, everything is fine visually if you do not take into account the white thin strips on the edges of the screen in the menu (they gone away while playing). The bigger sore was just OpenAl. Well, maybe you understand "libopenal1" instead of "libopenal", I did not begin to delve into how to replace the reference. Because of this thing, there's no sound in the game(game trying to catch up a "libopenal.so". I hope you will be all right with this (in any case, the demo version is attached).
